categories.main_business_segments: CNOOC Limited primarily operates in upstream oil and gas exploration, development, production, and sales. Its business segments include conventional oil and gas, shale oil and gas, oil sands, and other unconventional oil and gas activities. Additionally, it has a trade business segment handling crude oil trading and a corporate segment for management, finance, and R&D activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced offshore oil and gas exploration and production technologies, including deepwater and ultra-deepwater drilling, enhanced oil recovery techniques such as thermal recovery for heavy oil, and intelligent oilfield construction with digital and AI technologies. It also utilizes floating production storage and offloading (FPSO) vessels, subsea production systems, and has developed proprietary technologies for ultra-deepwater reservoir development and offshore platform automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CNOOC serves primarily energy companies and industrial customers in China and internationally. Its key customers include China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC Group), China Petrochemical Corporation (Sinopec), and various private refineries in China, as well as international buyers of crude oil and natural gas. The company’s markets span domestic Chinese markets and global markets, including Asia-Pacific, North America, South America, Africa, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are centered in Chinese offshore regions including the Bohai Sea, Western and Eastern South China Sea, East China Sea, and onshore China. Internationally, it has assets and operations across Asia (excluding China), Africa, North America, South America, Oceania, and Europe, with significant projects in countries such as Brazil, Guyana, Nigeria, Iraq, Canada, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: CNOOC operates primarily in the upstream segment of the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on exploration, development, production, and sales of crude oil and natural gas. It also engages in trading activities but does not operate in midstream or downstream refining and retail sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include increasing reserves and production through exploration and value-driven acquisitions, expanding natural gas business aligned with low-carbon development, and maintaining prudent financial policies. R&D focuses on exploration theory innovation, deepwater and ultra-deepwater technology, enhanced oil recovery, digital transformation, and green technologies such as offshore wind power and carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS).
categories.revenue_model: CNOOC generates revenue primarily through the sale of crude oil and natural gas products, both domestically and internationally. Revenue streams include product sales under long-term contracts and spot sales, as well as trading activities. The company also earns income from leasing FPSO vessels and from investments in joint ventures and associates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CNOOC is one of the largest independent oil and gas exploration and production companies globally and the largest offshore oil and gas producer in China. It competes with other major Chinese oil companies such as China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) and Sinopec, as well as international oil majors. Its competitive advantages include a strong reserve base, advanced offshore technology, and diversified global asset portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, CNOOC reported total assets of approximately RMB 1.056 trillion and net confirmed reserves of 7.27 billion barrels of oil equivalent. The company achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 137.9 billion in 2024, representing an 11.4% increase year-over-year. Oil and gas production reached 726.8 million barrels of oil equivalent, growing 7.2% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong financial position with a capital debt ratio of 10.9%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CNOOC emphasizes its large-scale, high-quality oil and gas reserves and leading production growth capabilities, particularly in offshore and deepwater environments. It leverages proprietary technologies and digital transformation to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs, maintaining a competitive cost structure with a barrel of oil equivalent cost of $28.52. The company also focuses on sustainable development through green energy integration and low-carbon initiatives, positioning itself as a reliable and innovative energy supplier.
